_template_info.description: Master template for Luke's NGAI agent specs. All fields marked with 'tier' indicate the minimum tier at which that field is required. Fields without a tier annotation are required at all tiers.
_template_info.usage: Copy this file, rename to <agent_id>.json, remove _template_info, and fill in all fields required for your chosen tier.

description: <One sentence: what does this agent do and why does it exist?>

inputs.name: <input_name>
inputs.description: <What is this input and where does it come from?>

side_effects: <Tier 2+> List any persistent state changes, file writes, API calls with side effects, etc.

tools: <external tool or API the agent relies on>

config._description: Runtime-configurable values with defaults. Add any agent-specific settings here.

auth._description: API keys, tokens, or credentials required. Never store values here — list names only.

commands: <command to run tests, e.g. pytest tests/test_<agent_id>.py>

observability.logging: <What should be logged and at what level?>
metrics: <Key metrics to track, e.g. latency, token usage, success rate>

scaling.concurrency: <Can this agent run in parallel? Any limits?>
scaling.rate_limits: <Any external API rate limits to be aware of?>
